name: Local sentence-to-pipeline demo
summary: A downloadable Python app accepts a natural-language task and emits cheap, balanced, and quality-first LLM pipeline blueprints with cost estimates, guardrails, eval kits, and deployment files.
example_prompt: Build me an LLM pipeline that intakes a photo plus description and processes it in the cheapest way possible to classify whether it may relate to human exploitation.
cost_controls: human review only on high-risk or uncertain cases

name: Verified government fact update propagation
summary: A vetted government or agency publisher submits a signed fact update with jurisdiction, effective date, license, and revocation handle; dependent pipelines receive impact analysis and review tickets.
example_fact: Philippines employment agency fee rule update for OFW placement workflows.
privacy_controls: public facts separated from tenant-private use

name: Guardrail and eval kit marketplace
summary: Guardrails, eval datasets, rubrics, and policy gates are registry objects that can be selected, tested, rated, and swapped like tools or models.
example_prompt: Compare cheap and quality-first moderation pipelines for a high-risk image-plus-text classification workflow.
privacy_controls: eval data must be synthetic or licensed
cost_controls: record cost per true positive and review ticket
